name: 03 Provider sessions and terminals
intro: How agents run: AsmAI's pinned provider copies and per-session settings, sign-in, the daemon-owned terminals and hook intake, the input fence and positive submission acknowledgment, the modal allow-list, the attach client and status line, taking and releasing an agent, and recordings. One question comes from a silence in the sources; everything else is stated as already decided. When you accept it I commit it and start 04 Conversation and Lavish.
notes: Rule 18 names the kinds of hook event, not exact hook names: which hooks each provider version emits is qualified (C7, C12, C15), and the probe saw them differ between Claude Code and Codex.
Rule 23 does not name the acknowledgment signal; the probe saw prompt-submission hooks from both providers, and C7 qualifies the signal for each version.
Rule 29 gathers the status line's contents from ADR 0004 with the holds and queue from AssemblyAI#14 and the restart notice from AssemblyAI#20.

Where AssemblyAI#7 says an agent at an unknown input state or with a self-updated CLI "pauses", the draft says it holds, per AssemblyAI#14. Detaching without releasing still leaves the agent "paused", because that stop is yours.
Recording retention is set here, because 03 owns recordings; 07 points here.
Where the pinned copies live on disk is left to implementation; no ticket decides it.
